drivers.explanation: Repeated prior-auth delays have led to patients abandoning before first fill, and the fix ETA keeps slipping, so Sablewood is unhappy and has an open escalation.
Median time to first fill is 13.3 days and refill adherence is 70.4%, both signs the program is not converting enrollments into steady therapy.
Active patients fell 11.5% over 90 days and portal users fell 11.1%, a moderate decline that is likely tied to the access problems.

tool_input.next_step: Call Aiko this week to get a firm, dated fix plan for the prior-auth backlog, and confirm a named owner and a first-fill recovery target before the escalation goes further.
